name: agent-memory-mcp
description: Persistent cross-session memory for AI agents — store, recall, search, and summarize memories across agent boundaries
author: THRONE

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory for an agent with optional TTL auto-expiry

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve relevant memories by keyword search, sorted by relevance and recency

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Delete memories by exact key, wildcard prefix, or clear all

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Accumulated knowledge about a user/entity aggregated across all agents

tools.name: summarize_session
tools.description: Store a session summary with key decisions and unresolved items

tools.name: search_across_agents
tools.description: Cross-agent memory search across all stored memories

tools.name: get_memory_stats
tools.description: Memory usage dashboard with per-agent counts and type distribution
